name: Cootie catcher
summary: The paper fortune teller from fourth grade, folded out of the chat's plans: tap a color and it pumps open and shut once per letter, tap one of the numbers that shows and that flap lifts to tell your fortune; everyone's fortune stacks up beside it and any of them can be locked in as the plan.
useWhen: we literally can't decide friday, let the paper thing pick
make a cootie catcher for what we do tonight
fortune teller but it picks dinner
let fate decide, here are 8 ideas
remember those paper fortune tellers lol make one
dontUseWhen: a fair random pick everyone must accept (use plan-spinner)
a vote where the most popular wins (use after-vote)

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Friday, decided by paper'

quote.description: What started it, in their words

colors.description: Four flap colors as words; each pumps once per letter, e.g. ['pink', 'blue', 'green', 'yellow']

fortunes.description: Up to eight short fortunes (the chat's plan ideas), under flaps 1 to 8
